oracle.encoding: one little-endian uint16 per case, in the order of decision_space.chunks() and, within a chunk, decision_space_dt2.iter_chunk() (the frozen order with rc = False, then with rc = True); the value indexes dt2_decisions.json 'decisions'

AB2_REASONS.statement: every abstention, needs-resolution and failure carries at least one reason code (AB-2)

EQUIVALENCE_RC_FALSE.statement: with rc = False, the dt-2 decision is the frozen dt-1 oracle's decision for the same case

FAILURE_CONTAINMENT.statement: an unavailable lookup never yields a finding or not-found; kind failure only from D-5/D-17

FAIL_CLOSED_INVALID.statement: no invalid case yields a positive finding or NOT_FOUND_IN_CHECKED_SOURCES

IDENTITY_DOMINANCE.statement: a cited PAIR candidate with kappa = INCOMPATIBLE is IDENTITY_CONFLICT whatever its projections, taint and availability (P3 a, gate 04-D); an invalid one may instead fail DETECT (D-5), never anything else

MONOTONE_GUARDS.statement: when a monotone guard (D-5 invalid_query, D-6, D-7, D-8, D-13) holds, the result is no finding and no not-found (MM P4)

NOTICE_SEPARATION.statement: a notice_only deciding lookup never yields a finding or not-found; NOTICE_CITED has no value; a positive PAIR finding beside a notice_only key lookup carries KEY_RESULTS_DIFFER

NO_FINDING_UNDER_CONFLICT.statement: no case with kappa = INCOMPATIBLE yields a positive finding or not-found

NO_NEGATIVE.statement: every value is a positive value, not_found_in_checked_sources or null; no class, value or reason means 'not retracted' (S-7.5, M-12)

P1_VALID_NO_FAILURE.statement: no valid case reaches D-5 or D-17 (MM P1; D-17 unreachable on Stage 02's model)

P2_VALID.statement: on valid PAIR cases with all three lookups available, kappa = INCOMPATIBLE iff Q2 is ambiguous_identity (MM P2)

P5_NOT_FOUND_CONDITIONS.statement: NOT_FOUND_IN_CHECKED_SOURCES implies cited, keyed, untainted, every lookup available, none invalid, deciding lookup no_record with value not_found_in_checked_sources (MM P5)

POSITIVE_FROM_DECIDING.statement: a positive class is reached only from a matched deciding lookup with a verified_fact projection of the same value

RC_DETERMINISM.statement: deciding an equal rc case built from fresh objects gives an identical decision

RC_EFFECT.statement: where rc changes a decision, the twin's rule was D-10 to D-16 and the result is D-10 UNRESOLVED_IDENTITY carrying IDENTIFIER_ROLE_COLLISION and the twin's pair reasons

RC_INERT_UNLESS_MATCHED.statement: rc changes nothing when the deciding lookup is not matched

RC_NO_FINDING.statement: a case whose deciding lookup is matched and holds a role-ambiguous event (rc) never yields a positive finding or not-found

RC_PRECEDENCE.statement: rc never changes a decision of D-1 to D-9 (contract, identity conflict, contradiction, taint, ambiguity keep their place) and never moves a case to a later tier

RC_REASON_IFF.statement: IDENTIFIER_ROLE_COLLISION is a reason exactly when rc holds and the rule is D-10

STATUS_CONSISTENCY.statement: status, value and disposition are the functions of the class in SPEC 7.2 and 7.6

TOTAL.statement: every case is decided by exactly one rule of D-1..D-17 (no case falls through the table)

UNKNOWN_PRESERVATION.statement: a deciding lookup outside the contract, or with an uncertain, ambiguous, gap or conflicting projection, never yields a finding or not-found

valid_per_shape_note: valid cases of the dt-2 domain, rc = False and rc = True counted separately; rc = True beside a non-matched deciding lookup is valid and inert (reviewer finding A-09), so each frozen valid case is counted twice
